test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 5 persons P, B, S, V and T are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). V and T are not immediate neighbours. There is only one person to the right of S. P and S are immediate neighbours. No one is sitting to the left of T. P is sitting next to B. Who is sitting at the right end of the row?
solution:
Given: Five persons P, B, S, V and T are sitting in a row facing north.

No one is sitting to the left of T.

Only one person is to the right of S.

P and S are immediate neighbours.

P is sitting next to B.

V and T are not immediate neighbours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa17d667b9380a664db0333ffa46075397e0f57cce1ce1fb6175caa1940af85c.png] 

Right end = V

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
